## ConnectionsModule.receiveInvitationFromUrl() method

Receive connection invitation as invitee encoded as url and create connection. If auto accepting is enabled via either the config passed in the function or the global agent config, a connection request message will be send.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
receiveInvitationFromUrl(invitationUrl: string, config?: {
        autoAcceptConnection?: boolean;
        alias?: string;
        mediatorId?: string;
    }): Promise<ConnectionRecord>;
```

| Parameter     | Type                                                                     | Description                                           |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| invitationUrl | string                                                                   | url containing a base64 encoded invitation to receive |
| config        | { autoAcceptConnection?: boolean; alias?: string; mediatorId?: string; } | <i>(Optional)</i> config for handling of invitation   |
